resolution.summary: Implemented and tested audit accuracy safeguards: narrow recommendation capture, explicit remaining-work review, bounded verification details, and Git hook/runtime diagnostics. Configured unit verification runs in an isolated worktree using process-local bundled Git; system Git shell runtime is missing.

remaining.summary: Kiosk device coverage and its historical Git executable are not independently verified. Optional review preserves old clients; arbitrary intent and omitted obligations still require agent review.
Repairing the global Git installation and publishing or installing this DIP revision are outside this code change.
